::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru fabless pioneer whose Pruthvi software-defined radio chips launched in 2015; Pruthvi-3 (28nm FD-SOI) followed in December 2018. Tejas Networks (Tata group) acquired a 64.4% stake in 2022. Clients have included ISRO and BEL; its DLI project is a 5G baseband SoC.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Software-defined radio SoCs for broadcast (ATSC 3.0, 5G broadcast), satellite-terrestrial communications and 5G telecom baseband.
